consequence.statement: Ambient now uses REDIRECT instead of TPROXY for traffic redirection; for most users this has no impact.

original.statement: Ambient's traffic redirection method changed from TPROXY to REDIRECT; for most users no impact, and it fixes some TPROXY compatibility issues.

decision.reason: [ev-c46155ca9794] says Ambient's redirection method changed from TPROXY to REDIRECT, and that this "should have no impact" for most users while fixing some TPROXY compatibility issues. The note does not say anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so no action-eligible kind is supported. Because it only says "most users", some environments may still see different runtime behaviour, so "none" would go too far. That makes a low-severity behavior-change (review) the right reading.
